basis: Named PMTiles Spean Thmor bridge POI17592756541329, about280m northeast of the older catalog coordinate, agrees with the21July2025 photo location. No exact-QID outline or dimensional survey is present. Heading follows the nearby older east-west road corridor and the inferred photo-facing south side; approximate rather than independently surveyed. The8-bay,16.8m visible-remnant interpretation and broken outer extent are provisional reconstruction controls; photographs establish stepped corbels, broken slabs and two root systems, not a measured complete bay schedule.

vector.note: The extract keeps zooms 0-maxLevel, so the archive also carries layers the app never reads: landcover (zoom 0-7), earth, boundaries and places.
